programs.title: The 90-Day Pelvic Support Program
programs.subtitle: Build pelvic support, manage pressure, and move with less heaviness.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Learn lift, release, and pressure control without straining.

days.title: Feel Supported From the Start
days.intention: Your first skill is coordination, not a harder squeeze. Inhale and let the pelvic floor soften; exhale and add a gentle lift, then let it go completely.

days.title: Lift Without Straining
days.intention: Glutes and deep abdominal muscles share the work around your pelvis. Today builds that support without asking the pelvic floor to grip all day.

days.title: Breathe Before Effort
days.intention: Practice breathing out just before you rise or lift. This gives pressure a controlled path and trains the timing that can reduce downward pressure and heaviness.

days.title: Ease End-of-Day Heaviness
days.intention: Add gentle strength around the hips and trunk while keeping your breath moving. Endurance comes from repeatable control, not one maximal squeeze.

days.title: Support for Standing
days.intention: Bring your new timing into standing, walking, and steps, the moments heaviness often appears. Move slowly enough to stay connected to your breath.

days.title: Move With Less Pressure
days.intention: Rehearse everyday pressure changes with steady posture and an easy exhale. The goal is automatic coordination without clenching.

days.title: Your Pelvic Support Baseline
days.intention: Repeat the foundations and notice what changed during coughing, standing, walking, or urgency. Coach Mia™ will use your check-in to shape the next week.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Build a clear pelvic lift and a complete release.

days.title: Find the Gentle Lift
days.intention: You will practice clean squeezes: full squeeze, full release, and never hold your breath. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Build the Support Team
days.intention: Strong glutes share the support load through your pelvis, and today we build them on purpose. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Pressure-Smart Core
days.intention: Controlled core work today trains your system to manage pressure under tension. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Release Between Reps
days.intention: Today's work tunes the timing between your inhale, exhale, and pelvic lift. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Stand, Lift, Exhale
days.intention: Today you take control out of the mat and into how you actually move all day. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Support That Lasts
days.intention: A focused strength session today keeps your progress climbing week over week. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.
